answer: Proof of Stake functions as a Sybil resistance mechanism by requiring capital lockup, turning each agent into a pearl of value within the network. An attacker attempting to simulate an echo of multiple identities must stake proportional collateral, ensuring the cost of consensus manipulation remains prohibitively expensive. By acting as a prism to refract trust through economic weight, the system forces attackers to bear the full financial burden of their deceit, securing the decentralized ledger.
